#!/bin/sh
set -eu
CERT=/etc/pki/tls/certs/node1-8443.crt
KEY=/etc/pki/tls/private/node1-8443.key
RENEW_BEFORE=604800
DAYS=30

if [ "\${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /etc/pki/tls/private/node1-cert.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
[ -n "$ip" ]
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days "$DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=node1" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$ip" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/key.pem" -out "$tmpdir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 "$tmpdir/key.pem"
chmod 644 "$tmpdir/cert.pem"
chown root:root "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$tmpdir/cert.pem"
mv -f "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$KEY"
mv -f "$tmpdir/cert.pem" "$CERT"
restorecon "$KEY" "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT

# /etc/systemd/system/node1-cert-renew.timer
[Unit]
Description=Daily certificate expiry check for node1 HTTPS

[Timer]
OnCalendar=daily
RandomizedDelaySec=1h
Persistent=true
Unit=node1-cert-renew.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

# /etc/systemd/system/node1-cert-renew.service
[Unit]
Description=Renew node1 HTTPS certificate when within 7 days of expiry
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/renew-node1-cert
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
CERT=/etc/pki/tls/certs/node1-8443.crt
KEY=/etc/pki/tls/private/node1-8443.key
RENEW_BEFORE=604800
DAYS=30

if [ "${1:-}" != "--force" ] && [ -s "$CERT" ] && [ -s "$KEY" ] && openssl x509 -checkend "$RENEW_BEFORE" -noout -in "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    exit 0
fi

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d /etc/pki/tls/private/node1-cert.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT HUP INT TERM
ip=$(hostname -I | awk '{print $1}')
[ -n "$ip" ]
openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -sha256 -nodes -days "$DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=node1" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1,IP:$ip" \
    -keyout "$tmpdir/key.pem" -out "$tmpdir/cert.pem" >/dev/null 2>&1
chmod 600 "$tmpdir/key.pem"
chmod 644 "$tmpdir/cert.pem"
chown root:root "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$tmpdir/cert.pem"
mv -f "$tmpdir/key.pem" "$KEY"
mv -f "$tmpdir/cert.pem" "$CERT"
restorecon "$KEY" "$CERT" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

if systemctl is-active --quiet nginx; then
    nginx -t
    systemctl reload nginx
fi
current_cert_healthy_for_7_days=yes
